cmd_opts.description: List of raw command-line options passed directly to ares. Each item is one argument.

rom_path.description: Absolute or user-relative path to the ROM directory. Defaults to ares' default ROM directory.

system_path.description: Absolute or user-relative path to the system directory (BIOS/firmware). Defaults to ares' default system directory.

shader_path.description: Absolute or user-relative path to the shader directory. Defaults to ares' default shader directory.

video_enabled.description: Whether video output is enabled. Must be boolean.

audio_enabled.description: Whether audio output is enabled. Must be boolean.

video_resolution.description: Desired video output resolution in 'widthxheight' format (e.g., '1920x1080'). Empty string means default.

audio_sample_rate.description: Audio output sample rate in Hz. Common values: 44100, 48000, 96000.

input_enabled.description: Whether input devices (controllers, keyboards) are enabled. Must be boolean.

network_enabled.description: Whether networking functionality is enabled. Must be boolean.

logging_enabled.description: Whether logging is enabled. Must be boolean.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logs. Valid values: 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'. Empty means default.

plugins.description: List of plugin names or paths to load at startup. Each item is a plugin identifier.
